hypothesis: For exact retained seed-3788 JSON, one complete load/validation/all-role construction followed by reuse costs less than per-request loading/validation/selected-role construction over 1,000 identical requests, with exact predictions.
treatment: Fifteen paired alternating AB/BA blocks; each arm processes the identical fixed 1,000-request role A/B/C schedule. Reload includes file read, parse, digest/schema/shape validation, selected-role construction and scoring per request. Reuse includes one complete read/validation/all-role construction in initialization lifetime cost, then scores the same requests.
decision: PASS_LIFECYCLE_AMORTIZATION_SCOPED only if construction matches 12,288/12,288 retained predictions; formal reconciles all 30,000 predictions arm-to-arm and to retained predictions; independent raw-only audit has zero errors and rejects all seven mutations; reuse wins at least 12/15 blocks; median lifetime ratio <=0.90; and median first cumulative break-even request <=1,000, with noncrossing blocks censored at 1,001. Identity/runtime/audit failure is STOP, semantic mismatch is FAIL, unmet performance gate is HOLD. No retry or pooling.
control: Same immutable package, rows, corrected scorer, schedule, process boundary, image and CPU; only lifecycle differs. Startup excluded equally; reuse initialization included; reload repeats full load/validation/construction per request. AB/BA order alternates.
uncertainty: One synthetic package/seed, 15 paired blocks, cached linux/amd64 emulated Python image, pure-Python scorer. No PyTorch/framework speed, broad workload, skill efficacy, GUI/task effect, production latency or product claim. Does not close #4916.
